d:
Watch ‘Aila Aila’ from ‘I’ a fast paced track sung by Aditya Rao & Natalie Di Luccio. A.R. Rahman gives a variety of flavors in the number written by Karky. Natalie Di Luccio’s stylish tone with Aditya Rao’s rustic voice gives the song a fun feel and makes it instantly foot tapping.
Song Name - Aila Aila
Movie - I
Singer - Aditya Rao & Natalie Di Luccio
Music - A.R. Rahman
Lyrics - Karky
Director - Shankar
Starring - Vikram, Amy Jackson
